observations: Photo 0 shows a rectangular game console lying flat, wrapped in a red custom skin/decal featuring Liverpool FC crest, 'EST. 1892', and 'You'll Never Walk Alone' text.
A black strap or band is visible across the middle of the console.
The console sits on a tiled floor, shot from directly above.
No controllers ('pads'), game discs, cables, or power adapter are visible in the photo.
A 'SHOW GAMES' watermark is overlaid on the image, indicating it is a reseller/stock-style photo rather than a photo of the actual item in hand.
The exact body shape, vents, and port layout of the console are obscured by the skin and camera angle, making the console generation hard to confirm.

read_from: photo 0 (red Liverpool FC skin, shape partially visible)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a skinned console but the body shape/ports that distinguish PS4 Fat ('big') from PS4 Slim are not clearly visible under the wrap and camera angle.
No controllers appear anywhere in photo 0; only the console unit is shown.
No game discs or game cases are visible in photo 0.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Console generation (PS4 Fat vs PS4 Slim vs PS4 Pro) cannot be confirmed, which materially changes value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear port panel and side profile showing the console's physical shape without the skin obscuring it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-value variant consistent with visible shape (worst case)

risks.risk: Claimed 2 controllers, 7 games, and 'complete accessories' are not shown at all.
risks.proof: A single photo laying out the console, both controllers, all 7 game cases/discs, and cables together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, with no pads, games, or accessories included

risks.risk: Functionality (powers on, reads discs, controllers pair, HDMI output works) cannot be assessed from a static photo.
risks.proof: A short video of the console powering on, showing the home screen, and a controller connected.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / unverified condition

risks.risk: The red skin is a decal/wrap, not a factory finish; condition of the shell underneath (cracks, yellowing, prior repairs) is hidden.
risks.proof: A photo with the skin partially peeled or a close-up of an edge/corner showing the shell beneath.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible hidden shell damage

risks.risk: Stock/watermarked photo ('SHOW GAMES') suggests this may not be an actual photo of the unit being sold.
risks.proof: A fresh, unbranded photo of the actual unit in the seller's possession, ideally with a handwritten note/date.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified listing authenticity; priced conservatively

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console's rear panel and side profile (unskinned area or label) to confirm PS4 generation/model.
Photo showing both controllers, all 7 games, and all accessories laid out together with the console.
Short video of the console powering on and displaying the home screen.
A fresh photo of the actual unit (not a stock/watermarked image) taken by the seller now.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly show the console's generation (which sets the price for this kind of item), and none of the claimed included items (controllers, games, accessories) are visible, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without a clearer identifying shot.
